d: A humanoid cyborg with a sleek, athletic build and an apparent maturity of a young adult. The head is encased in a black, armored helmet featuring a glowing purple four-pointed star on the visor and a visible mouth filled with sharp, yellow-gold teeth. The outfit consists of a high-tech, form-fitting combat suit in a palette of deep black and vibrant magenta, featuring a segmented bodice and armored plating on the limbs. BODY COLOR: Black and magenta LEGS: Plantigrade with armored boots
